title: Cube Collector

entities.desc: a blue cube (2x2x2 units) that moves on the ground plane, controlled by player input, positioned at (0,1,0)
a flat ground plane (50x50 units) at y=0, colored light gray
a yellow sphere (1 unit radius) floating at random positions above ground, appears at (x,2,z) where x,z are random
a red cube (2x2x2 units) that roams randomly on ground plane, moves at 3 units/sec, positioned at (x,1,z) where x,z are random

camera: third-person follow camera, positioned behind and above player at offset (5,3,-5), always looking at player position
mechanics: player moves on ground plane (y=1) in 3D space using WASD keys
player collides with collectible spheres when distance < 1.5 units
player collides with enemy cubes when distance < 2 units
collecting spheres increases score by 10 points
touching enemy cube ends game with lose condition
lose: player collides with any enemy cube
